paper_citation: Yu Zhong, Koray Ozturk, Zi-Kui Liu, Thermodynamic modeling of the Ca-Sr-Zn ternary system, JPE 24, 340-346 (2003).
quote: Schottmiller et al. [1958Sch] determined the liquidus and solidus by thermal analysis with an uncertainty about ±2 °C. They prepared alloys from 99.8 wt.% Ca and doubly distilled 99.7 wt.% Sr in Fe crucibles in an argon atmosphere. The liquidus has a minimum at about 738 °C and 62 at.% Sr.
